text:
Stennis Bank financed the Garrow Heights housing scheme, according to the Garrow Heights Development Financing Agreement, a copy of which has been filed with the Harlow Vale Planning Registry.

The agreement, signed on 14 March 2023, provides a total construction loan facility of £84.6 million for the 420-unit development. Marguerite Ostrander, Director of Municipal Lending at Stennis Bank, signed for the lender.

The financing was announced at a signing ceremony held at Garrow Heights town hall. The registry filing records the facility as covering construction of the full 420-unit scheme.

The document identifies Stennis Bank as the sole lender named in the agreement. The Continental Record reviewed the filing in preparing this report.
